method: Independent stdlib parser of immutable completed legacy-schema1 raw streams, exact Git and copied sources, retained old ELF, disk bytes, proc identity records, helper logs, wait records, evdev frames and actual host FTDI sink. No project runner imported/called.
authorship: Reviewer authored earlier journal storage slice, not recovery executor or negative QEMU harness. This is independent raw-evidence reconstruction, not an independent audit of the authored storage implementation.

direct: Actual old/current proc exe path/hash/UID/PID/start snapshots, exact original durable grants, real waits, same old disk bytes through both bounded windows, no auto event in seven complete-line helper checkpoint logs, explicit guard stderr, two successful root reconcile responses, three actual HID/FTDI cycles and105B host sink.
source_constraints: The two sysfs bind writes are attributed to frozen legacy-only guest tail, followed by observed full driver restoration; no syscall trace independently identifies the writer.
Pure interval performs disk/sysfs/proc reads; startup doctor/Status occurs earlier. Primary precedes later pending/new-grant, not every helper API since startup.
Schema1 maps to ManualOnly in current frozen product code; disk1 intentionally has no recovery field or authorization summary.

limits: One negative legacy-producer upgrade scenario with manual recovery tail; neither its20s rejection nor5s restored-pending observation is automatic restoration success.
81 polling samples and review assertions are evidence counts, not USB cases; three actual client I/O cycles and two guests only.
Only new current opt-in grants after explicit manual retirement upgrade disk1 to disk2; mixed old/manual plus simultaneously new opt-in disk2 migration is not exercised.

Retained legacy ELF was independently rehashed. Current ELF/initramfs not retained here; current identity relies on recorded build/payload/after chain plus guest helper proc-exe hash, not rehash of absent current executable.
No real hardware, cross-configuration/alternate, arbitrary FD revocation or power-loss durability conclusion; P/C separate runs outside this report.
Killed epoch has no final backend resource snapshot and none is fabricated.
